name: Impacts, Booms & Sub Drops
when_to_use: Hook first frame, the key point or stat landing, title or logo reveal, end of a riser, punch-in on an emphasis word, beat drop, smash cut to black or to the result, end-card CTA.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 01
sounds.desc: A loose, reverberant cinematic boom with a slight echo and a long ~6 s tail; land a title card or big statement, fading the tail if voice continues.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 01 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Cinematic Boom 01: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 02
sounds.desc: A deep cinematic boom with strong low end and a fast attack; hit the hook's first frame or a key stat landing.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 02 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Cinematic Boom 02: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 03
sounds.desc: A tight, kick-like boom heavy in sub bass; punch an emphasis word, a beat drop or a smash cut.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 03 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Cinematic Boom 03: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Digital Boom 01
sounds.desc: A loose, echoing boom with digital time-stretch artifacts in the tail; land a glitchy title, a 'system' reveal or an AI-topic key point.

sounds.name: Digital Boom 01 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Digital Boom 01: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Digital Boom 02
sounds.desc: A reverberant cinematic boom with a bitcrushed, pixelated edge; pair it with glitch transitions or a pixel-text title landing.

sounds.name: Digital Boom 02 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Digital Boom 02: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 01
sounds.desc: A 1.7-second digital horn blast like a glitched fog horn, a braam-style hit for a hook opener or a system-failure beat.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 02
sounds.desc: A 2-second digital horn that swells to its loudest point right at the end, for leading hard into a cut or a reveal.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 03
sounds.desc: A short 1.4-second pure, steady digital horn tone, for a clean braam under a title or a bold statement.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 04
sounds.desc: The deepest of the digital fog horns, swelling over 2 seconds then fading, for a heavy dramatic reveal or a hook opener.

sounds.name: Gritty Crunch Boom 01
sounds.desc: A short, sub-heavy, crunchy explosion hit decaying in under a second, for landing a stat or a beat drop; it is game-flavoured, so use it sparingly.

sounds.name: Gritty Crunch Boom 02
sounds.desc: A 1.5-second deep crunchy explosion with heavy sub and a rumbling tail, for a big reveal or a title slam.

sounds.name: Gritty Crunch Boom 03
sounds.desc: A 2-second, very deep, sub-dominated boom with a long rumble, for the end of a riser or a logo reveal.

sounds.name: Low Sub Boom 01
sounds.desc: A deep 2-second sub boom with a soft attack and nothing above about 500 Hz, for layering under a stat landing, logo reveal or beat drop.

sounds.name: Short Sub Drop 01
sounds.desc: A short pure low tone diving down in pitch, mostly sub bass; use under a stat landing or emphasis word as a quick bass drop.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 05
sounds.desc: A deeper 2.7-second digital fog-horn braam that ends abruptly, for a dramatic title card or an ominous statement.

sounds.name: Gritty Crunch Boom 04
sounds.desc: A 1.3-second sub-heavy crunchy explosion with a longer rumble tail, for a smash cut to the result or a hook-open hit.

sounds.name: Gritty Crunch Boom 05
sounds.desc: A mid-heavy crunchy blast with a slightly soft attack and little sub, for a gritty emphasis hit on a key point.

sounds.name: Low Sub Boom 02
sounds.desc: A shorter 1-second deep sub boom with a soft attack, for adding low weight to a key-point hit or smash cut.

sounds.name: Muffled Metal Thud 01
sounds.desc: A dull, heavily low-passed metal knock with almost nothing above 400 Hz, usable only as a quiet low layer under an emphasis hit.

sounds.name: Muffled Metal Thud 02
sounds.desc: A short pure sub thump with no highs at all, for layering a subtle low punch under a caption keyword.

sounds.name: Sub Laser Thump 01
sounds.desc: A 0.4-second low sub thump with nearly all its energy under 60 Hz, for a subtle bass punch under a word or stat.
